{07 00 00}I heard that you're not as
terrible at fishing as I
thought, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}But you gotta learn that 
fishing isn't just about
catching just anything.
{07 19 00}You gotta take your fishing
skill to the next level and
catch something special.
{07 15 00}You know, catch a rare fish
and {01 00 00 05 00}prove to everyone{01 00 00 05 00}
that you're hardcore!
{07 00 00}So, {01 00 00 05 00}how about you and me 
have a showdown {07 0d 00}to see
who's the hardest of cores!

{07 15 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00} how about you
and me have a little
showdown, angler to angler.
{07 00 00}And don't even think we're 
competing for size or 
quantity.
{07 14 00}Oh no, {01 00 00 05 00}we're gonna compete
to see who can catch {01 00 00 05 00} 
the rarest fish out there!

{07 14 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} We're
gonna compete to see who
can catch the rarest fish!
{07 04 00}And by rare I don't mean 
undercooked!{07 03 00}{01 01 00} {07 16 00}...'Cause
that'd be kinda slimy.
{07 00 00}By rare, I mean that there
aren't a whole lot of them
around, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
If you catch somethin'{01 00 00 05 00}
that's hard to find, 
bring it here, {04 02 00}!
{07 15 00}Then we'll see who had the
rarest catch!{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}So...{01 00 00 0f 00} Are you
up to it?!
